summary: The framing consistently distinguishes an actual-support bound, a finite numerical leaf, a local compiler receipt, and a complete exclusion certificate. My exact integer checks support the stated numerical contribution without establishing the universal combinatorial bridges. The manuscript explicitly leaves those bridges and the boundary exclusions open, and describes representation reductions as counts rather than measured speedups. No revision is required from this bounded round-one check.
